newsitem.title: USA: BPA drops Wed shoulder hour prices to $15-16/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA drops Wed shoulder hour prices to $15-16/MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) cut prices for firm power during Wednesday shoulder hours (0700, 1100-1700, 2100-2200 PST) to $15.00 and $16.00 per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Tuesday.
But no power was offered during morning and evening peak hours.
BPA had offered up to 500 megawatts for Tuesday peak load hours at $25.00 per MWh for Northwest deliveries and $26.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
For Wednesday, BPA continued offering firm off-peak power at $12.50 per MWh for all deliveries.
Non-firm prices for shoulder hours were also lowered, to $16.00 (Northwest) and $17.00 (COB), while off-peak prices were at $12.50-13.50.
BPA also continued to offer displacement power for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PST at $9.00 per MWh, while adding offers for Northwest buyers only at $7.00.
